meta.source_text: 11QPsᵃ (11Q5); 11QApocryphalPsalms (11Q11) preserves an exorcism use of this psalm

preamble.summary: Psalm 91 — the protection psalm. 11QPsᵃ preserves this psalm in its standard MT form. 11QApocryphalPsalms (11Q11) preserves Psalm 91 within an exorcism collection, suggesting its early apotropaic use — relevant context for Jesus' citation at the temptation (Matt 4:6 / Luke 4:10–11).
preamble.notable_variants: Used apotropaically in 11Q11 alongside otherwise-unknown exorcism songs. No significant content variants. Minor orthographic variation only (the standard Qumran plene-spelling tendency).
preamble.scroll_condition: Fragmentary attestation; no continuous DSS coverage.
